pages.title: Dawn Template
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r A 50% additional chance to appear in loot chests of dungeons, stronghold libraries, woodland mansions, ancient cities, and end cities.$(br2)§lUse: §r Smithing upgrade template. At a Smithing Table, combine Dawn Template + Sword of the Free Will + Dawn Star to upgrade into Sword of the Free Will · Eternal Spark.
